about_the_game:
Explore a colorful world with your feline hero in this 2D side-scrolling demo. Jump, catch birds and navigate the environment with agility, all while evading obstacles and animals.

Features:
- Simple & intuitive gameplay
- Cute birds and animals
- Cat skins to customize your character
- Steam achievements
- Beautiful music

This Demo features one World with 10 Levels to explore, plus an exclusive Bonus Level. Test your skills and get a taste of what’s to come!
